name: S1 checkpoint identity and decision cache

test_list.description: Health identity requires a valid 32-byte digest paired with a nonzero model generation.
Changing checkpoint identity, load generation, question schema, masked text, or context causes a miss.
A digest-key collision with different serialized request bytes is rejected as a miss.
Insertion beyond capacity evicts the oldest entry and switching model identity clears prior cached requests.
Health omits model identity while the worker has not loaded its native model.
The identity covers required model artifacts, ONNX runtime bytes, text normalization, and engine thread count.
Repeated requests are not served from a cache when authenticated health omits model identity.
A response spanning a worker identity change is not tagged with the new generation.

inputs.name: model_identity
inputs.description: The worker-computed digest and load generation for the currently loaded model/runtime/normalization inputs.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The complete schema, already-masked primary text, and optional context.

output_description: An in-memory cache bounded by 256 entries and four MiB of combined serialized request/decision bytes, keyed by loaded-model identity and the full request. Cache lookup rechecks fresh authenticated identity; stored request bytes are compared on hits.
